meta.title: Beach Girl Property Rentals — Old Orchard Beach, Maine
meta.description: Owner-managed vacation rentals steps from the beach in Old Orchard Beach, Maine. Direct booking with Jill — no middleman.

hero.subhead: Four units, one quiet street, five minutes from the sand.

owner.title: Owner-managed means
owner.p1: Four units in the same building means I can host couples, big families, and reunions of up to sixteen — all on the same quiet street, all five minutes' walk from seven miles of sand.
owner.p2: When you message me, you're talking to me. I usually reply within the hour, and I'm the one handing you the keypad code on arrival. No app middleman, no support ticket queue.
owner.p3: If something's not right during your stay, I want to hear about it — and I want to fix it.
